summary.text: Ted Philips, listed by Ballotpedia as Edward Philips, is a Democratic state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 8th Norfolk District since January 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A former legislative aide and staff director, he vice chairs the Joint Committee on Transportation.

paragraphs.text: Philips was born in Boston and lives in Sharon, Massachusetts, and he graduated from Sharon High School.

He earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Massachusetts Amherst in 2005 and a master of public administration from the Suffolk University Sawyer School of Business in 2011.
His career experience includes work as a legislative aide, committee director and staff director.
Philips assumed office on January 6, 2021, succeeding Louis Kafka.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the House Human Resources and Employee Engagement Committee and the Joint Committees on Revenue and on Transportation, where he is vice chair.
